Peking Union Medical College Hospital was established in 1921 by the Rockefeller Foundation.
It is considered one of the most reputable hospitals in China due to its precision and dedication to actively improving its care.
Currently, PUMCH has four major campuses spread over 620,000 square meters.
The hospital has 2000 beds and manages 59 medical departments with a team of 4200 qualified medical staff.
Peking Union Medical College Hospital is a Class-A tertiary hospital with 59 clinical departments and offers various medical treatments.
The hospital gets over 3.26 million patients, and more than 73,000 surgeries are performed with advanced medical technology each year.
PUMCH also offers short-term educational programs for visiting foreign students.
These courses last 1-2 weeks and allow students to rotate across 35 medical departments.
PUMCH is a major research hospital in China that has received national and international recognition for its work in translational medicine and precision health.
The hospital has a primary State Clinical Research Center and two ministerial laboratories.
It also supports a mega Translational Medicine and Clinical Pharmacology Research Center project, approved by the Chinese Central Government alongside other top hospitals.
*   5 academicians from the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the Chinese Academy of Engineering.
*   2 winners of the National Science Fund for Distinguished Young Scholars.
Peking Union Medical College Hospital established its Clinical Pharmacology Research Center in 1995.
It is the biggest Phase 1 drug trial in China.
The center runs over 300 trials and has 36 drug/equipment trial groups.
It is CFDA certified and has an independent Ethics Committee.
